subject: general
question: The Arabian Sea is an extension of which of the following oceans?
solution:
The correct answer is **Indian Ocean**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Arabian Sea is a region of the northern Indian Ocean.
 
• It is bounded on the west by the Arabian Peninsula and on the northeast by the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The Arabian Sea has been historically significant for maritime trade routes connecting the Middle East, Africa, and India.
 
• It is an important region for monsoon winds, which influence the climate of surrounding regions.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Pacific Ocean
 Largest and deepest ocean, located to the east of Asia and west of the Americas.
 
 

 Southern Ocean
 Encircles Antarctica and merges with the southern parts of the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans.
 
 

 Arctic Ocean
 Smallest and shallowest ocean, located in the Arctic region and surrounded by Eurasia and North America.
